questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: HOT
questions.explanation: Hot: the opposite temperature; hot is very warm, cold is very low in temperature. So "cold" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: GENEROUS
questions.explanation: Generous: giving freely; stingy means unwilling to give or spend. So "stingy" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: VICTORY
questions.explanation: Victory: winning; the reverse is losing, i.e. defeat. So "defeat" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: EARLY
questions.explanation: Early: before the expected time; the reverse is after it, i.e. late. So "late" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: TRUTH
questions.explanation: Truth: what is true; the reverse is what is untrue. So "falsehood" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: STRONG
questions.explanation: Strong: having great physical power; weak lacks it. So "weak" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: LOVE
questions.explanation: Love: deep liking; hatred is intense dislike. So "hatred" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: ACCEPT
questions.explanation: Accept: to take what is offered; reject is to refuse it. So "reject" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: EXPAND
questions.explanation: Expand: to become larger; shrink is to become smaller. So "shrink" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: CLEAN
questions.explanation: Clean: free from dirt; dirty is the reverse. So "dirty" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: ARRIVE
questions.explanation: Arrive: to come to a place; depart is to leave it. So "depart" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: INCREASE
questions.explanation: Increase: to become greater; decrease is to become less. So "decrease" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: SAFE
questions.explanation: Safe: free from risk; dangerous is full of risk. So "dangerous" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: EMPTY
questions.explanation: Empty: containing nothing; full contains as much as possible. So "full" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: LAUGH
questions.explanation: Laugh: to express joy aloud; weep is to cry in sorrow. So "weep" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: PERMANENT
questions.explanation: Permanent: lasting indefinitely; temporary lasts only a while. So "temporary" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: OPTIMISTIC
questions.explanation: Optimistic: expecting good outcomes; pessimistic expects bad ones. So "pessimistic" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: RIGID
questions.explanation: Rigid: unable to bend or change; flexible can adapt. So "flexible" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: ARROGANT
questions.explanation: Arrogant: overly proud of oneself; humble has a modest view of oneself. So "humble" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: TRANSPARENT
questions.explanation: Transparent: allowing light to pass through; opaque does not. So "opaque" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: VOLUNTARY
questions.explanation: Voluntary: done by choice; compulsory is forced or required. So "compulsory" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: PRAISE
questions.explanation: Praise: to express approval; criticise is to express disapproval. So "criticise" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: LETHARGIC
questions.explanation: Lethargic: lacking energy; energetic is full of it. So "energetic" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: GENUINE
questions.explanation: Genuine: real; counterfeit is a fake made to deceive. So "counterfeit" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: BENEVOLENT
questions.explanation: Benevolent: wishing good for others; malevolent wishes harm. So "malevolent" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: CONCORD
questions.explanation: Concord: agreement and harmony; discord is disagreement. So "discord" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: INFLATE
questions.explanation: Inflate: to fill with air or enlarge; deflate is to let air out. So "deflate" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: VERBOSE
questions.explanation: Verbose: using too many words; concise uses just enough. So "concise" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: CRUDE
questions.explanation: Crude: in a natural or unpolished state; refined is processed or polished. So "refined" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: MANDATORY
questions.explanation: Mandatory: required by rule; optional is left to choice. So "optional" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: VACANT
questions.explanation: Vacant: not in use; occupied is in use. So "occupied" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: TIMID
questions.explanation: Timid: lacking courage; bold is confident and daring. So "bold" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: DELIBERATE
questions.explanation: Deliberate: done on purpose; accidental happens by chance. So "accidental" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: FERTILE
questions.explanation: Fertile: able to produce crops; barren cannot. So "barren" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: ENCOURAGE
questions.explanation: Encourage: to give hope or confidence; discourage removes it. So "discourage" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: HASTEN
questions.explanation: Hasten: to make something happen sooner; delay makes it later. So "delay" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: LAVISH
questions.explanation: Lavish: spending or giving in great quantity; frugal is sparing. So "frugal" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: RELEVANT
questions.explanation: Relevant: connected to the matter at hand; irrelevant is not. So "irrelevant" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: SHALLOW
questions.explanation: Shallow: of little depth; deep goes far down. So "deep" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: ASCEND
questions.explanation: Ascend: to go up; descend is to go down. So "descend" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: MUNIFICENT
questions.explanation: Munificent: very generous in giving; miserly is hoarding and unwilling to give. So "miserly" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: LUCID
questions.explanation: Lucid: easy to understand; obscure is hard to understand. So "obscure" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: AUDACIOUS
questions.explanation: Audacious: willing to take bold risks; timid shrinks from them. So "timid" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: BENIGN
questions.explanation: Benign: gentle or harmless in effect; malignant is harmful or deadly. So "malignant" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: TACITURN
questions.explanation: Taciturn: habitually saying little; talkative speaks a lot. So "talkative" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: INEPT
questions.explanation: Inept: lacking skill; skilful has it. So "skilful" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: MAGNANIMOUS
questions.explanation: Magnanimous: generous and forgiving in spirit; petty is small-minded. So "petty" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: INTREPID
questions.explanation: Intrepid: fearless and enduring; cowardly lacks courage. So "cowardly" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: OBSCURE
questions.explanation: Obscure: not clearly seen or understood; evident is plainly visible. So "evident" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to the word: PRODIGAL
questions.explanation: Prodigal: spending recklessly; thrifty saves carefully. So "thrifty" is the antonym. The other options are synonyms or unrelated words.
